clue.text: Middle-of-the-road dullard in a complicated situation

parts.note: MOR is the standard abbreviation for middle-of-the-road, as in bland radio music
a dullard is a fool, an ass

explanation.surface: A dull, conventional person finds themselves caught up in a messy predicament.
explanation.definitionFit: A morass is figuratively a bog of difficulties, a tangled mess from which escape is hard.

clue.text: Flowering growth of reformed Maoism

clue.text: Robin Day and brother, each beset by all others

parts.note: the rest means all the others

explanation.walkthrough: Robin Day was a famous British political broadcaster; here 'Robin' alone is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The robin is popularly known by its old name, after the bird's red-orange chest feathers.

clue.text: Heavily taxing family thus with silver rings

kin means family, relatives

clue.text: Religious rebel keeping mass occult

clue.text: Possibly final half of illustrations

explanation.definitionFit: A final is an end-of-course test, one example of the broader class of formal tests.

clue.text: Country farm's last out-of-date eggs

indicators.note: last means only the final letter of the word farm is taken

parts.note: old means out of date
ova is the Latin plural for eggs

explanation.surface: Eggs gone stale on a farm.
explanation.definitionFit: Moldova is an Eastern European nation between Romania and Ukraine.

clue.text: Pack used to divine bit of baking has nothing to eat

indicators.note: to eat means to take inside, so the pastry word swallows the letter for nothing

parts.note: a tart is a baked pastry item

explanation.definitionFit: Tarot cards form a deck used by fortune-tellers to foretell the future.

clue.text: Boater is at once showing wear and tear

explanation.surface: A straw hat immediately looks worn out.

clue.text: Reckless plot to seize Washington area

clue.text: Runaway Lord Lucan's left off large vessel

explanation.walkthrough: Lord Lucan disappeared after a murder in 1974 and was never found. 'Lucan's' reads as possessive but is 'Lucan has'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cauldron is a big cooking pot, the kind witches stir.

clue.text: Uninterrupted narrow passage in the ear?

indicators.note: in the ear means as heard, so the word for a narrow passage is taken by its sound

parts.note: a strait is a narrow channel of water

explanation.definitionFit: Straight means continuous or without a break, as in five straight wins.

clue.text: Suit with its top hiding the bottom, where there's a warm seat?

parts.note: hearts is one of the four suits in cards

explanation.walkthrough: 'bottom' and 'seat' tempt a reading about trousers; here the seat is a spot by a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A hearth is the fireside floor, where one sits to be warmed by the fire.

clue.text: Poet works old-style English

parts.note: goeth is the archaic form of goes, meaning works or functions

explanation.surface: A poet writes in an archaic English style.
explanation.definitionFit: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe was the great German poet and dramatist who wrote Faust.

clue.text: Appearance of pressure in a body of dissenters

parts.note: a sect is a group that has broken away from mainstream belief
P is the symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: How pressure shows itself within a group of nonconformists.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is the look or outward appearance of something.

clue.text: After writing off sauna, e.g., proposes to discuss Labour venue

indicators.note: after says the rearranged letters come first, before the next piece

explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' suggests the British party; here it is one of the twelve labours of Hercules, cleaning King Augeas's filthy stables.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleansing these stables was the fifth of Hercules' twelve labours, so they are the site of one.

clue.text: Fast-growing tree ideally in ground

indicators.note: ground means crushed or milled, so the letters are pulverised and remixed

explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' looks like the soil the tree is in; it is the past tense of grind.
explanation.definitionFit: Leylandii is the Leyland cypress, a conifer notorious in Britain for rapid hedge growth.

clue.text: Constant hare-brained stuff in emergency housing?

parts.note: C is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

to pad is to stuff or fill out

explanation.surface: Steady, crazy material put into hasty emergency shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A crash pad is a place to sleep temporarily when you have nowhere else, makeshift lodging.

clue.text: Spending one's way out of a depression?

definitions.text: Spending one's way out of a depression?

parts.words: Spending one's way out of a depression?
parts.note: reads like economic policy to escape a slump, but it is shopping to lift a gloomy mood

explanation.walkthrough: 'depression' sounds economic, where governments spend their way out; here it is a personal low mood cured by buying things.

clue.text: Blaspheming French or almost wicked cases

RV is the Revised Version of the Bible

clue.text: Preserve that local geological formation

yon is a dialect word for that, used in some regions

clue.text: Politician's divided influence, referring to first answer?

clue.text: Some more guarantees over boring device

clue.text: Current runs under side of bridge? This may regulate it

clue.text: Forgetting 'Massachusetts', composed ditty about having a stubby feature

explanation.walkthrough: 'composed ditty' is the phrase made a song up, with its verb split; dropping MA leaves DESONGUP, reversed by 'about'.
explanation.definitionFit: A pug nose is short and flat, so a person with one has a stubby nose.

clue.text: Unpleasant clubs blooming
